text:
nicole: Quick sync: we accepted RFC to add a response envelope "rw_meta" that carries metadata separately from the outputs. customers with parser libs will break if we flip shape. need compatibility plan that is low-risk.

pete: Proposed approach: opt-in Accept header + tenant opt-in flag + a tiny server shim that converts envelope -> legacy flat shape when needed. No UA sniffing.

yara: We should add an explicit capability probe too: POST /v1/capabilities {client_id} -> {envelope: true|false}. makes client intent visible.

samir: +1 to probe. selection logic order: 1) Accept header -> envelope path, 2) tenant flag -> treat as envelope, 3) probe true -> envelope, else legacy. shim only for envelope->legacy translation.

pete: Header suggestion: Accept: application/redwood.v2+json. Also support X-Redwood-Client-Features: envelope=1 for older proxies. keep header parsing simple.

yara: Telemetry: emit events envelope.sent, envelope.fallback, envelope.error. Tags: tenant, route, model, migration.wave. Sample 100% for envelope flows, 2% for fallbacks.

nicole: Runtime notes: implement shim in serializer layer after token-join and before http encoder. Fast-path when header present; fallback to cached probe result when header absent. Cache probe results for 24h.

samir: Rollout flags: runtime.flags.envelope = off|opt-in|force. Default opt-in. force used during tenant-wide flips.

pete: Perf counters: envelope.translate.ms, response.size.bytes, serializer.alloc_kb. Structured responses may be slightly larger; track p50/p95.

yara: Rollout plan: 1) land probe endpoint + flags behind off; 2) add shim and telemetry in staging; 3) opt-in internal teams + SDK beta (10%); 4) ramp 25/50/100% opt-ins; 5) after stability window, flip "force" for tenants that pass checks; 6) publish deprecation timeline for legacy flat shape (9 months).

nicole: Automated rollback triggers: tenant error.rate > 2x baseline OR p95 latency +20% OR spike in parse errors -> flip tenant to legacy path and page oncall. implement quick flip script.

samir: Third-party SDKs: publish small compatibility helper that calls probe and sets header. Reach out to major SDK vendors with PRs.

yara: Docs snippet for probe and header:
```
# capability probe
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"client_id":"my-sdk-1"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/capabilities
# request envelope v2
curl -H "Accept: application/redwood.v2+json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

pete: Testing: add golden diffs for envelope vs legacy. add a fuzz test that inserts unexpected rw_meta keys and verify shim drops unknown keys for legacy output. Also run stress tests for serializer latency.

nicole: Security: rw_meta must not include PII by default. add a PR checklist step for security review.

samir: Ops: cache tenant flags in memory for 12h, invalidate on changes. Expose a metric "envelope.opt_in_rate" per-tenant. Add dashboards for envelope.fallback_rate and envelope.translate_latency.

ci-bot: CI: feature/envelope-compat -> staging (build 6201). tests: 210/212 passed, 2 flakes ignored. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Added alerts: "envelope.rollback_trigger" (p95 > 1s or error_rate spike) and dashboards for coverage and latency.

nicole: Owners: nicole (spec + docs), pete (runtime + shim), yara (SDK + vendor outreach), samir (ops + rollback hooks). Follow-up Monday 10am to review staging metrics.

pete: i'll open the shim PR and include the perf counters and flag toggles.

yara: i'll prepare the SDK helper and draft the migration guide.

samir: i'll wire alerts and the quick flip script.

nicole: keep the shim strictly translation-only: no enrichment, no behavioral changes. predictable rollback is critical. thanks all.
